From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 04 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Leadership demo — propose VP/CIO time swap for AuroraWorks

Hi Lydia & Tom,

Thanks again for the interest — excited to run a focused leadership demo next week tailored to AuroraWorks' procurement and security checklist. You mentioned the VP (Ms. Park) prefers mornings and the CIO (Tom) is only available later in the day. To keep the demo cohesive, would you be open to flipping the order so we hold the CIO deep-dive first and the VP overview immediately afterwards? That would let us start with architecture/security details while Tom's team is fresh, then close with the executive summary for Ms. Park.

Proposed blocks (Pacific):
- Option A: Tue 2026-10-12, 10:30–11:30 (CIO deep-dive) + 11:35–11:55 (VP executive recap)
- Option B: Wed 2026-10-13, 09:00–10:00 (CIO) + 10:05–10:25 (VP)

If these look problematic, happy to accommodate alternate windows — just want to avoid forcing folks to join a single block where they can catch just the parts most relevant to them.

Cc'ing Sean to loop in product and cover if calendars shift. I attached a short one-pager and will send a calendar invite once we lock time.

Cheers,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the options and the one-pager. Quick note on calendars: Ms. Park (VP) only has morning capacity on Tue/Thu next week; Tom (CIO) is booked mornings but can do mid-day or late afternoon. Swapping order could work — Tom has a hard stop at 12:30 on Tue, so Option A looks tight unless we start the CIO portion at 09:45 or earlier. Option B might be better for Tom if we shift the CIO slot to 11:00–12:00 and then the VP recap at 12:05–12:25, but Ms. Park prefers not to eat into her lunch meeting blocks.

Can you confirm whether the CIO deep-dive needs a full hour? If we can compress the technical review to ~45 minutes, Option A with an earlier start could be doable.

Lydia Park
VP, Product & Strategy | AuroraWorks
lydia.park@auroraworks.com | +1 (617) 555-0199

Sean / Priyom —

Forwarding Lydia's reply. Short asks:
- Can we compress the CIO technical walkthrough to 40–45 minutes without losing the key architecture/security demos? Priyom, can you draft a 40-min runbook that hits KV cache, quantization effects, and our routing/fallback story?
- If we need to start at 09:45 PT on Tue to accommodate Tom's noon stop, are you available to cover the VP recap at ~11:35 PT? If I'm tied up with an internal review I'll need you to close.

If we tighten the runbook, we can propose Tue 10:00–10:45 (CIO) + 10:50–11:10 (VP) which sits between the constraints Lydia mentioned. I'm happy to take the VP recap if the schedule allows.

Thanks — can you confirm by EOD so I can reply to Lydia with a firm option?

Marissa
